caption: The drawing shows a simple composition with a central yellow fruit that has a brown stem. The fruit is surrounded by a circular green wreath composed of stems with green leaves extending outward. The leaves are evenly spaced around the wreath. In the center, below the fruit, there is a handwritten name, "Emma Stokes," in red ink. The scene is set within a square border that is outlined in a thin brown line and another fine black line. The background is an off-white or cream color. The drawing is centered on a larger, plain, off-white paper.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
